title: Fasting
summary: Fasting involved abstaining from food for grief, repentance, prayer, urgency, or devotion to God.
background: Scripture treats fasting as serious and Godward, but also warns against outward religious display without humility and justice.
teachingHelp: When teaching fasting, emphasize dependence on God, humility, and sincerity rather than performance.
sources: Alfred Edersheim, Sketches of Jewish Social Life in the Days of Christ (1876).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
